import json
def shape(g):
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) for x in r if x==8]; cs=[j for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==8]
    return [[g[i][j] if g[i][j]==8 else 0 for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
def transform(g):
    S=shape(g); k=sum(x==4 for r in g for x in r)
    return [row*k for row in S]
